title: Tribute
description: A mod to give some love to the blocks almost forgotten.
body:
# Tribute

Have you ever felt like some blocks from Minecraft's past have been forgotten _too_ easily? Not _given_ enough love? Maybe you liked some blocks' previous versions that were _replaced_ with ones with newer textures? Tribute has _**more than enough**_ love to give for all of those. It also lets you convert blocks placed in your world on the fly, using the hourglass mechanics.
